summary: A mixed legal and corporate finance day. Delhi High Court clarifies court fee refunds as legal entitlements; Reliance plans up to $1 billion local currency bond fundraise; IRDAI insurance reforms may pressure NBFC fee income.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court rules full court fee refund is legal entitlement when dispute is settled, not discretionary.
Reliance Industries plans to raise up to $1 billion via local currency bonds to strengthen balance sheet.
IRDAI insurance reforms may pressure NBFC fee income; L&T Finance and Piramal Finance among most exposed.
India's consumer durables market projected to reach INR 3-3.25 lakh crore by 2030 with Rs 50,000 crore localisation opportunity.
Nykaa and L'Oréal's venture fund BOLD partner to jointly invest in Indian beauty and personal care brands.
